defs.def: from one end to or towards the other end of sth 沿着；顺着

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.
